attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Nursing (Division of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Contact hours earned through a Board-approved method or from an approved provider
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours for the first renewal depend on when the license was first issued (table on the board's renewal page).
rules.alternatives: Separate practice requirement for active licensees: 1,000 practice hours in the last 5 years or 400 hours in the last 2 years, or a refresher course completed within 2 years.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; certificates and practice verification are uploaded to DELPROS only when selected for audit.
rules.notes: CE is entered in the DELPROS CE tracker before renewal. The 1-hour topic covers recognizing and responding to abuse, exploitation, trafficking or domestic violence of vulnerable persons (children, elders, disabled) or the related reporting duties. RN periods end Feb 28, May 31 or Sep 30 of odd years.
rules.legal_basis: Delaware Board of Nursing Rules and Regulations, Section 9.2.1.1.1
